query: SELECT cp.id, cp.empresa, cp.valor, cp.ar_id, ar.valor_liquido, ar.valor_recebido_liquido, (CAST(ar.valor_liquido AS DECIMAL(12,2)) - CAST(ar.valor_recebido_liquido AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS valorAReceber FROM cobranca_planilha cp LEFT JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON cp.ar_id = ar.id WHERE cp.empresa LIKE '%RONALDO%' AND cp.ativo = 1
